newsitem.title: UK: IBCA confirms Comune di Roma currency ratings.
newsitem.headline: IBCA confirms Comune di Roma currency ratings.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Friday it had confirmed the foreign currency long-term rating of AA minus and domestic currency long-term rating of AAA for Comune di Roma.
"The ratings reflect the importance of the city of Rome together with a relatively high proportion of own revenue and a good control over expenses," IBCA said in a statement.

The agency said the current administration is now aiming at restructuring loss-making municipal companies - in particular transport companies - which mostly contributed to the relatively high level of financial debt. It said Rome was expected to receive significant financial transfers from central government to prepare for the Jubilee in 2000.
IBCA said it's ratings apply only to bond issues made by Comune di Roma which have received a delegation of payment.
